title: Activation Functions: A Reading Guide
description: Nine focused guides to activation values, gradients, numerical stability, SwiGLU, designing a function of your own, and the vanishing and exploding gradient problems.

title: Why Neural Networks Need Activation Functions
description: See where an activation sits, why linear layers collapse, and how its slope affects learning.

title: Sigmoid and Tanh: Bounded Outputs and Saturation
description: Understand bounded activations, derive their slopes, and separate hidden-layer saturation from probability outputs.

title: Stable Sigmoid: Avoiding Overflow in Exponentials, Log-Sigmoid, and Losses
description: Prevent exponential overflow with the two-branch sigmoid identity, preserve tail precision in log-sigmoid, and derive stable binary cross-entropy from logits.

title: ReLU, Leaky ReLU, and PReLU: What Happens Below Zero?
description: Follow ReLU through its gradient, then see how fixed and learned negative slopes change the behavior.

title: GELU and SELU: Gaussian Weighting and Self-Normalizing Scale
description: Unpack the Gaussian CDF and product-rule derivative for GELU, then compare ELU and SELU's exponential negative branch and self-normalizing conditions.

title: SiLU and Swish: Smooth Self-Gating
description: Explain sigmoid-weighted inputs, derive their slopes, and see how Swish scales the transition.

title: SwiGLU: One Learned Branch Controls Another
description: Build SwiGLU from SiLU, trace both branches and their gradients, and compare feed-forward blocks at equal parameter budgets.

title: Softmax: Turn Competing Scores into Probabilities
description: Explain vector-valued softmax, stable computation, its coupled derivatives, and the connection to cross-entropy.

title: How to Design an Activation Function
description: Build a smooth leaky activation from a desired slope, check its mathematics and numerics, and plan a fair training comparison.

title: Vanishing and Exploding Gradient Problems Across Activation Functions
description: Derive the L-layer backpropagation Jacobian product, understand the causes and effects of vanishing and exploding gradients, and compare every activation family in this series.

title: 1. Sigmoid and Tanh: Tail Saturation, the 1/4 Derivative Ceiling, and Mean Shift
description: Derive why Sigmoid's <= 1/4 slope and positive output range cause vanishing gradients and zig-zag updates, why Tanh still saturates in its tails, and when large weights trigger explosion.

title: 2. ReLU, Leaky ReLU, and PReLU: Dead Neurons and Unbounded Forward Growth
description: Derive why ReLU's zero negative slope causes permanent dead neurons and (1/2)^L variance decay under Xavier initialization, why its unbounded positive slope explodes without He scaling, and how Leaky ReLU and PReLU change the variance equation.

title: 3. GELU, ELU, and SELU: Gaussian Tail Decay, Overshoot Peaks, and Fixed-Point Breakdown
description: Derive GELU's exact zero-slope trough at z = -0.7518 and >1 slope peak at z = sqrt(2), and see why SELU's lambda = 1.0507 multiplier explodes when paired with He initialization or positive drift.

title: 4. SiLU and Swish: Zero-Slope Troughs, Origin Halving, and Beta Sensitivity
description: Derive SiLU and Swish's exact zero-derivative trough at beta*z = -1.2785, their universal 0.5 slope at the origin, their 1.0998 positive overshoot peak, and beta-driven gradient instability.

title: 5. SwiGLU: Multiplicative Gate Coupling and Quadratic Outlier Explosion
description: Derive why SwiGLU's elementwise product creates a coupled two-branch vanishing bottleneck when either branch is small, and why positive outliers make SwiGLU outputs grow quadratically and Jacobians grow linearly.

title: 6. Softmax: Logit-Gap Saturation, Rank-Deficient Jacobians, and Temperature Explosion
description: Derive why large logit gaps or unscaled attention dot products collapse the entire KxK Softmax Jacobian to zero, why Cross-Entropy cancels that vanishing factor while MSE stalls, and why small temperatures explode gradients by 1/T.
